title: feat(scripts): skills link/anchor gate and three liveness-exhaustive sections

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbPjpDtuAfMiZPGY3g5SZw34)_

Part of #31115 (items 1 and 2). Item 3 follows in a separate PR.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 新增 skills 链接/锚点检查 `check:skill-links`（按 GitHub 的标题锚点规则核对 `skills/**` 里每个相对链接），并让现有的标识符存活检查多守三张表：`requires:` 能力表、`os generate` 那一行、过滤运算符表；`os generate` 行顺手补全为 10 种类型。
- **为什么改：** 11 月 2 日的技能复审手工找到了 3 个失效锚点和这几张表的缺漏，而当时所有门禁都是绿的；这两项让同类问题以后在 PR 上直接变红（维护者已对新增门禁回复「同意」）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加检查脚本和一行技能文字，不改任何运行时代码；main 上新检查全绿（248 个链接 0 失效）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `scripts/check-skill-links.mjs`（锚点规则 `githubSlug`，误报风险所在）；`scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs`（新的 `literalMembersOf` 读取器与三条绑定）；`.github/workflows/lint.yml`（新增的一个步骤）。
- **两分钟验证：** 运行 `pnpm check:skill-links`，应看到自测 22 条全过，以及「248 relative link(s) … resolve」。
- **需要你做的：** 这是受管面 PR（`skills/**` 与 `.github/workflows/**`），需要一位受管审批人批准（APPROVED review）。

## What changes

- **`scripts/check-skill-links.mjs` (new) + `check:skill-links`.** Walks every `*.md` under `skills/**` and resolves each relative link: the file must exist, and a `#fragment` on a markdown target must match a heading slug under GitHub's own rule (rendered text, lower-case, punctuation and em-dashes deleted, spaces to hyphens with no collapsing, `-N` for repeats) or an HTML `id`/`name`. Fenced code, inline code spans, HTML comments, absolute URLs and fragments on non-markdown targets are not judged. Exit 0 / 1 (dead link) / 2 (prerequisite, including a lit control on the live link count). Battery-floored `--self-test` with the verdict handshake, copied from `check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs`; it reproduces the three moved-verbatim links from the review and pins each slug case (em-dash, code span, emoji, intra-word underscore, duplicates).
- **Wiring.** `package.json` `check:skill-links` (`--self-test && scan`); one step in `lint.yml` `typecheck-source-gates`, beside `check:skill-top-level-keys`, `continue-on-error` with an `id:` so the lane verdict carries it. No new job.
- **`scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs`: three Leg 2 bindings.**
  - `requires-capability-tokens`: platform SKILL.md `### requires:` section against `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` ∩ `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS`.
  - `generate-kinds`: operations.md `## Build & runtime`, row `os generate <kind>`, against `GENERATORS` minus `RETIRED_GENERATORS`; a retired kind listed in the row is its own red (`[leg2-retired-row]`).
  - `filter-operators`: filters.md `## Operator Reference` against `FILTER_OPERATORS` (`$empty` is a member, confirmed on main).
  - To read these, the gate gains `literalMembersOf` (a string array or an object literal's top-level keys, read by name with a character scanner that refuses spreads and computed keys), `intersect` / `minus` set algebra and an optional `row` scope on a binding. `extractSymbols` is unchanged, so `--suggest` is unchanged.
- **`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`.** The `os generate <kind>` row listed four kinds in prose; it now lists all ten. Two restating clauses in the same file's port table pay for the bytes (line count 180 → 180; tokens 3375 → 3370).
- **`.changeset/31115-skills-link-and-liveness-gates.md`**: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

## Why

All the mechanical skill gates were green while the 2026-11-02 review found these defects by hand. The maintainer approved the new gate (ruling 6708443569, 「同意」 to letter A). Items 2 and 3 widen existing gates onto their measured blind spots.

## Tests

<details><summary>Self-tests and scans at the final head</summary>

- `pnpm check:skill-links`: self-test 22 cases pass; scan "248 relative link(s) in 71 published skill file(s) resolve; 119 fragment(s) name a real heading".
- `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`: self-test OK (new battery "LEG 2: string arrays, object keys, set algebra and row scope", 15 cases; roster floor 10 → 11); scan OK, "Leg 2: 11 registered exhaustive section(s), 0 ledgered gap(s)".
- Live mutation (restored, `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards): `agent` added to the generate row reds `[leg2-retired-row]`; the `mailbox` row deleted from the requires table reds `[leg2-missing-row]`.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0 (operations.md 3370 / 3375).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the touched scripts: exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Re-measure of the card on main.** Item 1: the three named anchors already resolve on main (the text-fix cards #31130 and #31131 landed first); the new gate is green there. Item 2: `package-registry` and `mailbox` are already in the requires table, `$empty` already in the operator table, and the generate row no longer names `agent`; but the row listed only four of the ten kinds, so it was red as an exhaustive row and is fixed here.
- **Item 3 is not in this PR.** Where its `--fix` writes land (the release post-version guard reads `stampedSkillPaths()`, and the token ratchet prices body pins) is open with the maintainer; it follows in its own PR.
- **Not judged by the link gate:** whether a link that leaves `skills/` reaches a file that also ships in the published package.
- **`skills/**` readings:** operations.md 180 → 180 lines; the bundle (all SKILL.md) 4524 → 4524 lines.

## Verification

- Head `11be7732` (merge base `cd6618e88`). Full workspace `pnpm build`: 119 of 119 tasks.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 89 derived, 89 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. All 89 exit 0, rerun at this head after the item-3 revert, including `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` on the built tree.
- Left to this PR's check-runs: the artifact-roster and wide-population families, the path-scheduled CI jobs, the type-check lanes and the always-runs tail that dispatch-gates prints outside the derived total.
- Deviations: `dispatch-gates --tier` names claude-fable-5-1 for `skills/**` (clause 1); this was built on the default tier. The two port-table clauses in operations.md were deleted to pay the token ratchet for the longer generate row. Item 3 was committed and then reverted on this branch with `git revert` (no history rewrite), so `scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs` is byte-identical to main.
